title: Bat holding a heart
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">

  <path d="M50 40 Q70 20 90 25 Q82 35 88 45 Q75 42 70 50 Q65 40 55 45 Z" fill="#7a5cd6"/>

  <path d="M55 45 Q70 32 82 30" stroke="#9b82e8" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/>

  <ellipse cx="50" cy="58" rx="16" ry="20" fill="#9b82e8"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="40" r="14" fill="#b39df0"/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <path d="M40 30 L36 16 L46 26 Z" fill="#b39df0"/>
  <path d="M60 30 L64 16 L54 26 Z" fill="#b39df0"/>
  <path d="M40 29 L38 20 L45 27 Z" fill="#d4c5f9"/>

  <circle cx="44" cy="40" r="3" fill="#ffe066"/>

  <circle cx="56" cy="40" r="1.3" fill="#2a1a5e"/>

  <path d="M46 49 L46.8 53 L47.6 49 Z" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <path d="M52.4 49 L53.2 53 L54 49 Z" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- arms holding heart -->
  <path d="M38 58 Q34 56 32 60" stroke="#b39df0" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M62 58 Q66 56 68 60" stroke="#b39df0" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- heart -->
  <path d="M50 78 C50 78 34 68 34 58 C34 52 40 50 44 54 C47 57 50 62 50 62 C50 62 53 57 56 54 C60 50 66 52 66 58 C66 68 50 78 50 78 Z" fill="#ff4d6d"/>

  <path d="M42 60 C42 56 44 55 46 57" stroke="#ff8fa3" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx="43" cy="79" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#b39df0"/>
  <ellipse cx="57" cy="79" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#b39df0"/>
</svg>
